comparison.objective: Identify the short foot of a rocking motor base and shim only that foot; body and specs are absent.
comparison.physical_skill: Diagnosing rocking support geometry and placing a shim, not bimanual tool stabilization and hammer impact.
comparison.success_condition: Correct foot alone is shimmed and the base is stabilized; thresholds are unavailable.
comparison.reason: Support diagnosis and selective shimming do not test notch fracture, coil-safe tool use, or loose-fragment recovery.
